mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering investor concerns about weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in private demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) following a prior decline signals a recovery in private demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1.5% MoM after two consecutive monthly declines
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during recovery phases (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that may trigger a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS >= 1.5%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during co-expansion phases (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5% YoY), indicates a healthy expansionary environment that supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during expansion-inflation stability regimes (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
